personality.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
personality.hint: Scores translate into concrete behavior. The panel on the right shows what this profile produces.

traitDesc.extraversion: Low: reserved & brief · High: talkative, energetic, expressive
traitDesc.agreeableness: Low: blunt & challenging · High: warm, cooperative, supportive
traitDesc.neuroticism: Low: calm & even · High: reactive, emotionally intense

personality.radarHint: Grey = default (50). Red above, blue below.
